prompt.zh-CN: 【合规通知】报关与合规经理宣布：涉及受控货物、制裁名单匹配和出口许可证的单证一律禁止AI自动生成，必须由人工复核。
prompt.en-US: 【Compliance Notice】The Customs & Compliance Manager announces that documents involving controlled goods, sanctions screening, and export licenses are strictly forbidden from AI auto-generation and must be human-reviewed.

prompt.zh-CN: 【财务要求】CFO要求：自动化项目必须在下季度证明至少15%的投资回报，否则预算将被削减。
prompt.en-US: 【ROI Requirement】The CFO requires the automation project to prove at least 15% ROI next quarter, or the budget will be cut.

prompt.zh-CN: 【数据要求】IT与合规联合要求：所有客户及舱单数据必须留在境内，模型不得调用境外第三方大模型接口。
prompt.en-US: 【Data Requirement】IT and Compliance jointly require that all customer and manifest data remain in-region, and the model must not call offshore third-party LLM APIs.

prompt.zh-CN: 【韧性要求】运营总监要求：自动化系统在旺季舱位紧张时必须具备优雅降级能力，任何故障都不能阻塞人工订舱和报关通道。
prompt.en-US: 【Resilience Requirement】The Operations Director requires the automation system to degrade gracefully during peak-season capacity crunches, and no failure may block the manual booking and customs channels.
